# CONF-LIVE-002 — Protected Linux supervisor source candidate

## Status and authority

Alpha 2 is **ONGOING**. This packet is source-only. It neither installs a
launcher nor runs a native campaign. Unit receipts always retain
`nativeAcceptance=false`; a validated receipt is not tenant acceptance.
This document describes the implementation and its acceptance obligations, not
a claim that the obligations have passed. Exact commit/run evidence is recorded
separately at PR closure.

## Components and state

| Component | Dependency and responsibility | State / failure |
| --- | --- | --- |
| NativeSupervisor | Fixed installed launcher custody, three independent signature roles, exact signed files and kit, native adapter | One session per dedicated process; no caller context or backend argument |
| Native channel | Owned socketpair; per-message kernel credentials; pidfd, PID/start/cgroup/UID/GID/capability/namespace checks | Validate before and after blocking operations; death/EOF/cancellation invalidates handle |
| Cgroup lease | Preallocated empty root-owned cgroup-v2 leaf, finite CPU/memory/PID limits, exclusive session lock | Attach before releasing child gate; kill whole leaf, drain adopted descendants, prove populated=0 |
| Replay journal | Root-only no-follow file, exclusive flock, chained canonical JSONL, append + fsync + readback | RESERVED before child creation, RUNNING before operations, terminal only after cleanup |
| UnitSupervisor / UnitBoundary / UnitReplayStore | Explicit injected unit adapters | UNIT_VERIFICATION_ONLY, never installed authority |
| Fixed proxy successor | CONF-LIVE-003, later protected network/admission implementation | Missing module is PROTECTED_PROXY_UNAVAILABLE; no fallback |

Lifecycle:

`VALIDATED_DATA -> durable RESERVED -> containment + peer checks -> RUNNING -> COMPLETED / FAILED / CANCELLED / EXPIRED`

Terminal states have no outgoing edge. Only all ten fixed, distinct passing
operations can complete. A failed or unavailable operation closes the session;
an unavailable operation's receipt stays NOT_RUN_ENV_UNAVAILABLE. Cancellation
racing an already executing operation may end in FAILED (interrupted I/O) or
CANCELLED; neither permits reuse. Cleanup failure or clock rollback can leave
the durable record RESERVED/RUNNING **consumed**, with no fabricated terminal
receipt. Journal read errors, torn writes, uncertain fsync/readback, full storage
and custody changes all refuse execution. No truncation, repair, nonce expiry,
rotation or automatic lease recovery is implemented.

An append failure before any byte reaches storage may leave an empty journal
after process restart. That is safe only because execution never precedes a
successful durable reservation. Any complete or partial reservation survives
as consumed or as a globally refusing corrupted journal. Root/operator
tampering, disk rollback, hardware lying about fsync and hostile kernels are
outside this source candidate's trust boundary; production backup/restore must
preserve replay history and never restore a reusable old nonce ledger.

## Native boundary and custody

The production constructor accepts no path, executable, callback, module name,
storage adapter, FD, token or verified flag. It requires Linux, root UID/GID,
one thread, no preexisting children and default SIGCHLD disposition; the
module must be loaded from the exact installed launcher archive and its
independently signed root manifest must verify. The unchanged legacy launcher
continues to refuse live execution until the separately owned CONF-LIVE-006
bridge and external installation gates are complete.

The native entry also rejects ambient credentials, proxy/import variables and
open descriptors beyond nonsocket stdio. Only PATH, HOME, USER, LOGNAME, LANG,
LC_ALL, TZ and the fixed HARNESS_LIVE_EXECUTION_ENVELOPE input may be present;
none is an authorization flag. The child clears that remaining environment.
Manifest/public-key/signature/launcher bytes are read once under no-follow
custody, verified with the unchanged signature/key contract, and retained by
the dedicated process. Repeated internal native constructors use that verified
snapshot; the envelope's launcher digest must equal it.

Both platform and tenant signatures and fixed trust-store digests are verified
before opening any envelope-selected reference, including the capacity file.
Only then may that exact digest-bound capacity reference be read and its
independent CAPACITY_OPERATOR signature and complete binding verified. Invalid
or forged references therefore never reach a file open; none grants execution.

Authority references use retained no-follow directory/file descriptors, exact
root ownership, no write bits, single-link regular files, bounded reads and
inode/metadata rechecks. The signed kit is enumerated independently, with each
file read once. It rejects symlinks, hard links, device crossings, unsupported
objects, writable files, path aliases and inventory/digest drift. No warm
checkout or ambient root filesystem is used as a kit. The source candidate's
Fixed bounds are 4 MiB/file, 64 MiB total file data, 4096 files, 8192 total
entries, 4096 entries per directory and depth 32; the release must fit these
bounds or be unavailable.
A root-owned, nonwritable `rootfs/` inside that exact signed kit is required;
there is no host filesystem fallback. Packaging/prerequisite qualification is
not supplied by this packet.

Before any child checkout or credential access, trusted setup:

1. Creates a supervisor-owned SOCK_SEQPACKET socketpair and a closed child gate;
   marks the dedicated parent a child subreaper.
2. Forks a trusted setup child and attaches it to the exclusively leased cgroup
   before releasing the gate. An ambiguous attach still requires cleanup.
3. Clears supplementary groups and creates user, mount, PID and network
   namespaces; the parent writes exact single-ID UID/GID maps to host 65532.
4. Re-arms parent-death SIGKILL after credential changes. PID-namespace init
   retains a parent pidfd to close the death-before-prctl race even when
   getppid() is zero across the namespace boundary.
5. Makes mount propagation private; recursively bind-mounts the signed rootfs
   read-only/nosuid/nodev and chroots into it. Closes all descriptors except the
   owned local channel; removes capabilities and enables no_new_privs.
6. Installs architecture-checked classic-BPF seccomp rules. Direct socket
   creation/connect/bind/listen, namespace escape, ptrace, BPF, userfaultfd,
   io_uring and pidfd_getfd paths are denied on amd64/arm64. x32 is rejected.
   clone3 returns ENOSYS; ordinary clone/fork is allowed only inside the
   PID namespace, limits and cgroup. This is a layered boundary, not a claim
   that a syscall denylist alone is a complete sandbox.
7. Reports READY through per-message SCM_CREDENTIALS. The parent checks the
   child's kernel identity, exact cgroup, distinct namespaces, mapped UID/GID,
   zero capability sets, seccomp and no_new_privs, and retains a pidfd.

SO_PEERCRED from socketpair creation is deliberately not used as post-fork
sender identity. Truncated, duplicate or unexpected ancillary messages fail;
all received SCM_RIGHTS descriptors are closed and never become authority.
Only the supervisor-created channel is used, with checks around every bounded
operation. The isolated custodian presently accepts only a fixed ping byte;
it does **not** yet execute probes or load tenant credentials.

The child uses an absolute monotonic deadline (at most 900 seconds and never
past signed expiry), recalculated before each receive so pings cannot extend
its life. Parent death kills the trusted intermediate parent and namespace
init; PID namespace teardown kills remaining namespace processes. An alive
supervisor's expiry/cancel/close path writes cgroup.kill and drains direct and
adopted children until both wait custody and cgroup emptiness are proved.
Kernel/init reaping after supervisor death is a **native qualification gate**,
not something offline mocks establish. After a parent crash, an occupied
preallocated leaf blocks the next session instead of being silently cleared.

## Operator prerequisites — not performed here

The separately authorized native operator must provide a supported native
64-bit Linux host, Python 3.12.14 and the exact signed launcher, cgroup v2
including cgroup.kill, mount_setattr recursive read-only support, user/mount/
PID/network namespaces, pidfd, prctl/capset/seccomp, and enabled finite CPU/
memory/PID controllers. Unsupported primitives have no subprocess/emulation/
uncontained fallback. Missing prerequisites are NOT_RUN_ENV_UNAVAILABLE, never
PASS; the later bridge owns mapping internal prerequisite exceptions into the
unchanged campaign result format.

Fixed, precreated paths (not user request parameters):

- `/sys/fs/cgroup/planeon-live/session`: empty non-delegated cgroup-v2 domain.
- `/var/lib/planeon/live-backend`: root:root 0700.
- `session.lock` and `replay.jsonl` under that directory: root:root 0600,
  precreated regular files, no hard links. The journal starts empty once;
  never recreate it to clear consumed nonces.
- Existing root manifest, release trust and tenant trust fixed mounts under
  the unchanged trusted live-runner contract.

No install command, sudo policy, cluster/VM provisioning, rootfs creation,
credential import, cloud API, hosted runner or network policy mutation is part
of this source run.

## Handoff to CONF-LIVE-003 and remaining roadmap

The only production transport hook is the fixed relative import
`live_proxy_client.execute_protected(request, installed_context, deadline)`.
It is intentionally absent until its owning packet. Caller data never chooses
a transport/module/URL/argv. The context is constructed only by NativeSupervisor
and retains its owning supervisor, validated binding, plan, envelope, capacity,
source digest and owned rootfs FD. These are private in-process custody data,
not serializable session authority.

The privileged broker is distinct from the isolated child. CONF-LIVE-003 must
independently enforce the single signed endpoint, TLS identity, no discovery/
redirect/proxy environment, bounded request/response/deadline, short-lived
credential custody and server-side zero-cost quota admission. A live peer or
successful ping grants none of those permissions by itself. CONF-LIVE-004
owns the ten real fixed probes. CONF-LIVE-005 owns deterministic candidate
packaging; CONF-LIVE-006 owns the closed integration delta. External operator
installation, native amd64/arm64 Linux, OCP/Kubernetes runtime, assurance and
tenant acceptance remain separate WAITING gates.

## Offline verification and evidence boundaries

Run only the packet's exact eight direct argv through the signed, root-owned
offline launcher in one deny-all-outbound process tree: all six unittest roots,
then campaign linux-baseline and evidence-verify linux-baseline. No separate
test execution or native syscall execution is permitted during coding/CI.

New tests cover reserve-before-child ordering; nonce contention; crashes before,
during and after append/fsync/readback; consumed restart history; replay chain,
scope and timing; peer identity/FD spoofing; per-message credential rejection;
BPF instruction behavior for both ABIs and IPv4/IPv6/DNS/metadata denial;
namespace-clone escape filtering; adapter failure ordering; cgroup attach
ambiguity, adopted-child reaping and incomplete cleanup; one-operation locks,
cancellation, expired/late I/O and rollback; factory injection and unsigned
evidence. Syscalls are explicitly mocked; no test result is native
containment evidence. Inventory tests retain original 103/120, corrected
106/150, successor 110/170 and immediate 120/216 file/test checkpoints, including
fresh isolated discovery of all six roots without omission/skip/xfail.

Keep local-source checks, GitHub CI, PR merge, local exact-main replay,
candidate artifact/SBOM, installed preflight, native runtime, assurance and
tenant acceptance as independent states. Roll back this unconsumed increment
by a reviewed revert; after successor consumption use a corrective packet.
Do not alter installations, tenant resources, trust or replay history.

## Design references

- [Linux cgroup-v2 documentation](https://docs.kernel.org/admin-guide/cgroup-v2.html):
  process inheritance, resource limits and whole-cgroup kill behavior.
- [Linux seccomp filter documentation](https://www.kernel.org/doc/html/latest/userspace-api/seccomp_filter.html):
  architecture checks, no_new_privs and layered confinement.
- [Unix-domain socket credentials](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/unix.7.html):
  per-message SCM_CREDENTIALS versus socket-creation credentials.
- [User namespaces](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/user_namespaces.7.html):
  UID/GID mapping and supplementary-group ordering.
- [Parent-death signal](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/PR_SET_PDEATHSIG.2const.html)
  and [PID namespaces](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/pid_namespaces.7.html):
  re-arming, death races and PID-namespace init teardown.
- [Recursive mount attributes](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/mount_setattr.2.html):
  recursive read-only/nosuid/nodev enforcement.

## CONF-FIX-004 — retained custody correction

Alpha 2 remains ONGOING. This is a SOURCE-ONLY candidate. Local acceptance,
required localhost CI, merge and independent local exact-main are separate
pending gates until their exact commit/run records are published. No native
execution, installation, server containment or tenant acceptance is asserted.

The fence below retains that checkpoint as history, not corrected file hashes.

### Ownership and handoff

The fixed NativeSupervisor constructor creates one process/thread-bound internal
registry. A cached manifest digest, mocked reader return, caller FD, subclass,
foreign owner or deserialized object cannot complete its authority inventory.
Standalone legacy byte readers remain data-only and retain their signatures.

The registry retains every no-follow directory in the full chain, each regular
file FD and immutable bytes, and the named inode plus type/owner/mode/link/size/
mtime/ctime snapshot. Installed identity is verified once into that registry;
subsequent checks do not reopen any path or silently refresh trust. The signed
kit is enumerated once. Its verified rootfs directory is borrowed, not reopened.

InstalledContext carries read-only _bytes (absolute retained authority paths)
and _kit (signed kit-relative bytes), plus original signed authority and a
binding/plan snapshot. The fixed proxy successor consumes release/profile/CA/
observation-binding bytes from these maps only. These internal objects are not
public request APIs, independent signer proof, or native acceptance evidence.
The proxy must check the genuine active owner/channel before any credential
or network operation and keep its own server-side admission requirements.

A durable nonce reservation precedes containment. Every peer/request/hook
boundary rechecks retained custody, all three signer roles/windows and signed
scope. Wall and monotonic time cannot roll back or extend the original deadline;
checks repeat after blocking channel and proxy operations. Changed authority
fails closed and is not re-enrolled. The fixed fork setup remains unchanged:
only its required rootfs/channel are used; all other descriptors are closed
before isolated custodian operation. No authority data is sent over that channel.

### Bounds and failure behavior

Existing kit limits remain 4 MiB/file, 64 MiB kit data, 4096 kit files,
8192 kit entries, 4096 directory entries and kit depth 32. The complete registry
adds finite ceilings of 4112 files, 8448 descriptors, 96 MiB retained file bytes,
64 absolute path components and 4096 UTF-8 path bytes. Descriptors must be above
stdio and below the unchanged child's close-range ceiling. Kernel descriptor
exhaustion refuses immediately; no RLIMIT increase, reopen or partial fallback.

Registry invalidation precedes close attempts. Each descriptor number is removed
from ownership before a close can report failure and is never retried. A replaced
descriptor is rejected without closing the unrelated replacement. Cleanup
continues after individual errors. Clock failures cannot prevent containment
cleanup. An ambiguous reservation consumes the instance; consumed journal
history is never reset. Unproven cleanup/time leaves no successful terminal
record. Parent/native crash recovery remains a separately qualified Linux gate.

The four fixed runtime resource descriptors (session lock, cgroup, journal and
journal directory) are separately registered from the constructor's own objects,
not from an ambient-FD enumeration. The owned channel/pidfd pair is admitted only
after kernel peer validation. Ambient injection is rechecked before containment
and around each operation. These six fixed descriptors are additional to the
8448 retained authority/ancestor limit. Journal cleanup takes its two descriptors
once and attempts both even after an error; transaction and replay bytes remain
unchanged. Original retained inode identities prevent closing a recycled journal
descriptor as if it were still owned.

### Regression and evidence boundaries

Append-only regressions exercise the actual native factory, signature and
custody checks, reservation, channel and fixed-hook dispatch using explicit
in-memory OS observations. They do not patch an eligibility check to PASS.
They cover all retained paths and ancestor metadata; read-once/rootfs reuse;
each signer's expiry/revocation; forged/foreign/forked contexts; exhaustion and
read errors; post-I/O substitution; cancellation, clock failure, ambiguous
reservation and close-error cleanup. All results remain UNIT_VERIFICATION_ONLY.

The appended stdlib-only source guard reuses the pinned data-only region oracle,
checks all five corrected files and every unchanged file in the original
127-path inventory, preserves all original test/document bytes, and compares
fresh unittest collection to AST identity lists in all six roots. Stored source
text is never compiled, imported or executed.

Only all ten fixed, distinct passing\\noperations can complete. A failed or unavailable operation closes the session;\\nan unavailable operation's receipt stays NOT_RUN_ENV_UNAVAILABLE. Cancellation\\nracing an already executing operation may end in FAILED (interrupted I/O) or\\nCANCELLED; neither permits reuse. Cleanup failure or clock rollback can leave\\nthe durable record RESERVED/RUNNING **consumed**, with no fabricated terminal\\nreceipt. Journal read errors, torn writes, uncertain fsync/readback, full storage\\nand custody changes all refuse execution. No truncation, repair, nonce expiry,\\nrotation or automatic lease recovery is implemented.\\n\\nAn append failure before any byte reaches storage may leave an empty journal\\nafter process restart. That is safe only because execution never precedes a\\nsuccessful durable reservation. Any complete or partial reservation survives\\nas consumed or as a globally refusing corrupted journal. Root/operator\\ntampering, disk rollback, hardware lying about fsync and hostile kernels are\\noutside this source candidate's trust boundary; production backup/restore must\\npreserve replay history and never restore a reusable old nonce ledger.\\n\\n## Native boundary and custody\\n\\nThe production constructor accepts no path, executable, callback, module name,\\nstorage adapter, FD, token or verified flag. It requires Linux, root UID/GID,\\none thread, no preexisting children and default SIGCHLD disposition; the\\nmodule must be loaded from the exact installed launcher archive and its\\nindependently signed root manifest must verify. The unchanged legacy launcher\\ncontinues to refuse live execution until the separately owned CONF-LIVE-006\\nbridge and external installation gates are complete.\\n\\nThe native entry also rejects ambient credentials, proxy/import variables and\\nopen descriptors beyond nonsocket stdio. Only PATH, HOME, USER, LOGNAME, LANG,\\nLC_ALL, TZ and the fixed HARNESS_LIVE_EXECUTION_ENVELOPE input may be present;\\nnone is an authorization flag. The child clears that remaining environment.\\nManifest/public-key/signature/launcher bytes are read once under no-follow\\ncustody, verified with the unchanged signature/key contract, and retained by\\nthe dedicated process. Repeated internal native constructors use that verified\\nsnapshot; the envelope's launcher digest must equal it.\\n\\nBoth platform and tenant signatures and fixed trust-store digests are verified\\nbefore opening any envelope-selected reference, including the capacity file.\\nOnly then may that exact digest-bound capacity reference be read and its\\nindependent CAPACITY_OPERATOR signature and complete binding verified. Invalid\\nor forged references therefore never reach a file open; none grants execution.\\n\\nAuthority references use retained no-follow directory/file descriptors, exact\\nroot ownership, no write bits, single-link regular files, bounded reads and\\ninode/metadata rechecks. The signed kit is enumerated independently, with each\\nfile read once. It rejects symlinks, hard links, device crossings, unsupported\\nobjects, writable files, path aliases and inventory/digest drift. No warm\\ncheckout or ambient root filesystem is used as a kit. The source candidate's\\nFixed bounds are 4 MiB/file, 64 MiB total file data, 4096 files, 8192 total\\nentries, 4096 entries per directory and depth 32; the release must fit these\\nbounds or be unavailable.\\nA root-owned, nonwritable `rootfs/` inside that exact signed kit is required;\\nthere is no host filesystem fallback. Packaging/prerequisite qualification is\\nnot supplied by this packet.\\n\\nBefore any child checkout or credential access, trusted setup:\\n\\n1. Creates a supervisor-owned SOCK_SEQPACKET socketpair and a closed child gate;\\n   marks the dedicated parent a child subreaper.\\n2. Forks a trusted setup child and attaches it to the exclusively leased cgroup\\n   before releasing the gate. An ambiguous attach still requires cleanup.\\n3. Clears supplementary groups and creates user, mount, PID and network\\n   namespaces; the parent writes exact single-ID UID/GID maps to host 65532.\\n4. Re-arms parent-death SIGKILL after credential changes. PID-namespace init\\n   retains a parent pidfd to close the death-before-prctl race even when\\n   getppid() is zero across the namespace boundary.\\n5. Makes mount propagation private; recursively bind-mounts the signed rootfs\\n   read-only/nosuid/nodev and chroots into it. Closes all descriptors except the\\n   owned local channel; removes capabilities and enables no_new_privs.\\n6. Installs architecture-checked classic-BPF seccomp rules. Direct socket\\n   creation/connect/bind/listen, namespace escape, ptrace, BPF, userfaultfd,\\n   io_uring and pidfd_getfd paths are denied on amd64/arm64. x32 is rejected.\\n   clone3 returns ENOSYS; ordinary clone/fork is allowed only inside the\\n   PID namespace, limits and cgroup. This is a layered boundary, not a claim\\n   that a syscall denylist alone is a complete sandbox.\\n7. Reports READY through per-message SCM_CREDENTIALS. The parent checks the\\n   child's kernel identity, exact cgroup, distinct namespaces, mapped UID/GID,\\n   zero capability sets, seccomp and no_new_privs, and retains a pidfd.\\n\\nSO_PEERCRED from socketpair creation is deliberately not used as post-fork\\nsender identity. Truncated, duplicate or unexpected ancillary messages fail;\\nall received SCM_RIGHTS descriptors are closed and never become authority.\\nOnly the supervisor-created channel is used, with checks around every bounded\\noperation. The isolated custodian presently accepts only a fixed ping byte;\\nit does **not** yet execute probes or load tenant credentials.\\n\\nThe child uses an absolute monotonic deadline (at most 900 seconds and never\\npast signed expiry), recalculated before each receive so pings cannot extend\\nits life. Parent death kills the trusted intermediate parent and namespace\\ninit; PID namespace teardown kills remaining namespace processes. An alive\\nsupervisor's expiry/cancel/close path writes cgroup.kill and drains direct and\\nadopted children until both wait custody and cgroup emptiness are proved.\\nKernel/init reaping after supervisor death is a **native qualification gate**,\\nnot something offline mocks establish. After a parent crash, an occupied\\npreallocated leaf blocks the next session instead of being silently cleared.\\n\\n## Operator prerequisites — not performed here\\n\\nThe separately authorized native operator must provide a supported native\\n64-bit Linux host, Python 3.12.14 and the exact signed launcher, cgroup v2\\nincluding cgroup.kill, mount_setattr recursive read-only support, user/mount/\\nPID/network namespaces, pidfd, prctl/capset/seccomp, and enabled finite CPU/\\nmemory/PID controllers. Unsupported primitives have no subprocess/emulation/\\nuncontained fallback. Missing prerequisites are NOT_RUN_ENV_UNAVAILABLE, never\\nPASS; the later bridge owns mapping internal prerequisite exceptions into the\\nunchanged campaign result format.\\n\\nFixed, precreated paths (not user request parameters):\\n\\n- `/sys/fs/cgroup/planeon-live/session`: empty non-delegated cgroup-v2 domain.\\n- `/var/lib/planeon/live-backend`: root:root 0700.\\n- `session.lock` and `replay.jsonl` under that directory: root:root 0600,\\n  precreated regular files, no hard links. The journal starts empty once;\\n  never recreate it to clear consumed nonces.\\n- Existing root manifest, release trust and tenant trust fixed mounts under\\n  the unchanged trusted live-runner contract.\\n\\nNo install command, sudo policy, cluster/VM provisioning, rootfs creation,\\ncredential import, cloud API, hosted runner or network policy mutation is part\\nof this source run.\\n\\n## Handoff to CONF-LIVE-003 and remaining roadmap\\n\\nThe only production transport hook is the fixed relative import\\n`live_proxy_client.execute_protected(request, installed_context, deadline)`.\\nIt is intentionally absent until its owning packet. Caller data never chooses\\na transport/module/URL/argv. The context is constructed only by NativeSupervisor\\nand retains its owning supervisor, validated binding, plan, envelope, capacity,\\nsource digest and owned rootfs FD. These are private in-process custody data,\\nnot serializable session authority.\\n\\nThe privileged broker is distinct from the isolated child. CONF-LIVE-003 must\\nindependently enforce the single signed endpoint, TLS identity, no discovery/\\nredirect/proxy environment, bounded request/response/deadline, short-lived\\ncredential custody and server-side zero-cost quota admission. A live peer or\\nsuccessful ping grants none of those permissions by itself. CONF-LIVE-004\\nowns the ten real fixed probes. CONF-LIVE-005 owns deterministic candidate\\npackaging; CONF-LIVE-006 owns the closed integration delta. External operator\\ninstallation, native amd64/arm64 Linux, OCP/Kubernetes runtime, assurance and\\ntenant acceptance remain separate WAITING gates.\\n\\n## Offline verification and evidence boundaries\\n\\nRun only the packet's exact eight direct argv through the signed, root-owned\\noffline launcher in one deny-all-outbound process tree: all six unittest roots,\\nthen campaign linux-baseline and evidence-verify linux-baseline. No separate\\ntest execution or native syscall execution is permitted during coding/CI.\\n\\nNew tests cover reserve-before-child ordering; nonce contention; crashes before,\\nduring and after append/fsync/readback; consumed restart history; replay chain,\\nscope and timing; peer identity/FD spoofing; per-message credential rejection;\\nBPF instruction behavior for both ABIs and IPv4/IPv6/DNS/metadata denial;\\nnamespace-clone escape filtering; adapter failure ordering; cgroup attach\\nambiguity, adopted-child reaping and incomplete cleanup; one-operation locks,\\ncancellation, expired/late I/O and rollback; factory injection and unsigned\\nevidence. Syscalls are explicitly mocked; no test result is native\\ncontainment evidence. Inventory tests retain original 103/120, corrected\\n106/150, successor 110/170 and immediate 120/216 file/test checkpoints, including\\nfresh isolated discovery of all six roots without omission/skip/xfail.\\n\\nKeep local-source checks, GitHub CI, PR merge, local exact-main replay,\\ncandidate artifact/SBOM, installed preflight, native runtime, assurance and\\ntenant acceptance as independent states. Roll back this unconsumed increment\\nby a reviewed revert; after successor consumption use a corrective packet.\\nDo not alter installations, tenant resources, trust or replay history.\\n\\n## Design references\\n\\n- [Linux cgroup-v2 documentation](https://docs.kernel.org/admin-guide/cgroup-v2.html):\\n  process inheritance, resource limits and whole-cgroup kill behavior.\\n- [Linux seccomp filter documentation](https://www.kernel.org/doc/html/latest/userspace-api/seccomp_filter.html):\\n  architecture checks, no_new_privs and layered confinement.\\n- [Unix-domain socket credentials](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/unix.7.html):\\n  per-message SCM_CREDENTIALS versus socket-creation credentials.\\n- [User namespaces](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/user_namespaces.7.html):\\n  UID/GID mapping and supplementary-group ordering.\\n- [Parent-death signal](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/PR_SET_PDEATHSIG.2const.html)\\n  and [PID namespaces](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/pid_namespaces.7.html):\\n  re-arming, death races and PID-namespace init teardown.\\n- [Recursive mount attributes](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/mount_setattr.2.html):\\n  recursive read-only/nosuid/nodev enforcement.\\n\\n## Immutable immediate predecessor inventory\\n\\nThis is inert provenance data, never executable configuration. Its raw UTF-8\\nJSON (without a trailing newline) has SHA-256\\n`f2bc15e777afa6545c3fcfcdd63a0ddcba3d162783767083acb59e1744b115ac`, pinned independently in the new supervisor test.\\nOnly the previously accepted exact CONF-LIVE-006 hook proof can account for\\nthat final launcher delta; an integration filename alone never grants it.\\n\\n<!-- CONF-LIVE-001-BASELINE require(type(path) is str and path.startswith(\"/\") and \"\\\\\" not in path\n                and len(path.encode(\"utf-8\")) <= 4096\n                and all(p not in (\"\", \".\", \"..\") for p in ## CONF-FIX-005 — bounded late credentials and cumulative source evidence

Phase: Alpha 2. Authority: MET-REPAIR-012, meta main
047bae8d1eea35c17b1e2dcd6e7edaea558b78f5 (PR106). Product predecessor:
0aa3ef3027f4a156d7ebed1b56af244e021d080a, 127 files / 305 test identities.
Exactly five existing paths change; the other 122 files remain unchanged.
This is a source-candidate publication snapshot, not local/CI/main/live PASS.

The sealed original authority registry is unchanged. A separate, factory-owned
late-resource object binds the actual context, process, thread, scope and active
fixed operation. It retains one read-only 0400 credential and no-follow ancestry
across operations, bounded to 256 KiB and 66 persistent descriptors. There is no
caller path, FD adoption or configurable module/transport backend.

The fixed protected proxy may request one numeric-family, unconnected TCP socket
and one bounded sealed non-inherited memfd. The socket remains owned by this
lifecycle (the future proxy can use TLS MemoryBIO); it must not detach it or
transfer its descriptor to an independently close-owning SSL socket. The proxy
owns actual TLS/certificate validation, framing, connecting and current policy.
The memfd is closed after context loading, and all transient resources close
before any receipt is accepted. Failures invalidate first, attempt each owned
close once, preserve consumed nonce history and refuse recycled descriptors.

Private successor seam: only installed live_proxy_client.execute_protected may
use context._late_resources during its exact NativeChannel invocation. Its fixed
_require_current_credential_policy(context, deadline) must perform independently
current observation/admission and full profile validation, raising on any absent
or invalid prerequisite and returning no capability/token. It is called before
credential access and again after blocking work. CONF-LIVE-003 owns this guard;
it is NOT implemented as an always-success production stub here. Missing guard,
module custody or observer remains unavailable. No caller callback or boolean
can supply eligibility. The primitive's origin checks are not a strict-profile,
certificate, server authentication or live policy acceptance claim.

Tests exercise actual factory/custody/lifecycle code with mocked OS resources.
The explicit test-only proxy/policy adapter and origin-only profile are NOT an
operator observer implementation, cryptographic credential or native result.
No actual secret, socket connection, Linux installation or live probe is used.
The appended source-proof oracle checks all current delta bytes before exposing
historical views to unchanged old proof tests. Fresh AST versus unittest
collection checks every one of the 305 prior identities and all added tests.
Both historical source proofs, all behavioral assertions and stage inventories
110/120/127/135/141/146/151 remain independently enforced.

Acceptance is all eight declared argv commands in one signed offline tree,
then required localhost PR CI, merge and independent local exact-main. These
states are recorded separately in PR/operator evidence after each actual result.
Native AMD64/ARM64, artifact, deployment, runtime, assurance and tenant acceptance
remain NOT_RUN_ENV_UNAVAILABLE / WAITING. Alpha 2 ONGOING; effort transition NOT_DUE.

The second local candidate hit the unchanged 900-second trusted deadline; its
failure evidence is retained. The correction removes only redundant checks in
the new pure-data origin helper and immediate fixed-frame state transition.
Every predecessor peer check, all three signing roles, and all pre/post blocking
I/O policy and custody checks remain. No verification cache, test reduction,
signature mock, dispatcher or timeout change is introduced. New unit scenarios
print observed durations to make subsequent timeout diagnosis explicit.

**ONGOING**. This packet is source-only. It neither installs a\\nlauncher nor runs a native campaign. Unit receipts always retain\\n`nativeAcceptance=false`; a validated receipt is not tenant acceptance.\\nThis document describes the implementation and its acceptance obligations, not\\na claim that the obligations have passed. Exact commit/run evidence is recorded\\nseparately at PR closure.\\n\\n- Packet: CONF-LIVE-002, SHA-256 `05a6f03d19a1e12fafe278e5ec72c8adc6304766697b8682bc8d63092d47427f`.\\n- Meta authority: `3b1ea6b9b8514fbb51e37ba4703f5d06298bd938`.\\n- Immediate predecessor: CONF-LIVE-001, main `d734b80a3a5acebfd0e0d289437c0f53f3539054`,\\n  tree `5cf9cb3e1b286f6c16dcf77ccb4b5524ff568a44`, 120 files / 216 tests.\\n- Guide SHA-256: `1f1e62240ad6007c962e0a792787a6e5c569f6f72e3fde461868f72c77f034e0`.\\n- Trusted live-runner contract SHA-256:\\n  `69690c7bbe0899798f0c39e34e33c13dcd11fca470b8806be2c9c749a8622507`.\\n- Exactly seven additive paths. No predecessor, dispatcher, workflow, source\\n  lock, public schema, signature role or PORTING record changes.\\n\\n## Components and state\\n\\n| Component | Dependency and responsibility | State / failure |\\n| --- | --- | --- |\\n| NativeSupervisor | Fixed installed launcher custody, three independent signature roles, exact signed files and kit, native adapter | One session per dedicated process; no caller context or backend argument |\\n| Native channel | Owned socketpair; per-message kernel credentials; pidfd, PID/start/cgroup/UID/GID/capability/namespace checks | Validate before and after blocking operations; death/EOF/cancellation invalidates handle |\\n| Cgroup lease | Preallocated empty root-owned cgroup-v2 leaf, finite CPU/memory/PID limits, exclusive session lock | Attach before releasing child gate; kill whole leaf, drain adopted descendants, prove populated=0 |\\n| Replay journal | Root-only no-follow file, exclusive flock, chained canonical JSONL, append + fsync + readback | RESERVED before child creation, RUNNING before operations, terminal only after cleanup |\\n| UnitSupervisor / UnitBoundary / UnitReplayStore | Explicit injected unit adapters | UNIT_VERIFICATION_ONLY, never installed authority |\\n| Fixed proxy successor | CONF-LIVE-003, later protected network/admission implementation | Missing module is PROTECTED_PROXY_UNAVAILABLE; no fallback |\\n\\nLifecycle:\\n\\n`VALIDATED_DATA -> durable RESERVED -> containment + peer checks -> RUNNING -> COMPLETED / FAILED / CANCELLED / EXPIRED`\\n\\nTerminal states have no outgoing edge. Only all ten fixed, distinct passing\\noperations can complete. A failed or unavailable operation closes the session;\\nan unavailable operation's receipt stays NOT_RUN_ENV_UNAVAILABLE. Cancellation\\nracing an already executing operation may end in FAILED (interrupted I/O) or\\nCANCELLED; neither permits reuse. Cleanup failure or clock rollback can leave\\nthe durable record RESERVED/RUNNING **consumed**, with no fabricated terminal\\nreceipt. Journal read errors, torn writes, uncertain fsync/readback, full storage\\nand custody changes all refuse execution. No truncation, repair, nonce expiry,\\nrotation or automatic lease recovery is implemented.\\n\\nAn append failure before any byte reaches storage may leave an empty journal\\nafter process restart. That is safe only because execution never precedes a\\nsuccessful durable reservation. Any complete or partial reservation survives\\nas consumed or as a globally refusing corrupted journal. Root/operator\\ntampering, disk rollback, hardware lying about fsync and hostile kernels are\\noutside this source candidate's trust boundary; production backup/restore must\\npreserve replay history and never restore a reusable old nonce ledger.\\n\\n## Native boundary and custody\\n\\nThe production constructor accepts no path, executable, callback, module name,\\nstorage adapter, FD, token or verified flag. It requires Linux, root UID/GID,\\none thread, no preexisting children and default SIGCHLD disposition; the\\nmodule must be loaded from the exact installed launcher archive and its\\nindependently signed root manifest must verify. The unchanged legacy launcher\\ncontinues to refuse live execution until the separately owned CONF-LIVE-006\\nbridge and external installation gates are complete.\\n\\nThe native entry also rejects ambient credentials, proxy/import variables and\\nopen descriptors beyond nonsocket stdio. Only PATH, HOME, USER, LOGNAME, LANG,\\nLC_ALL, TZ and the fixed HARNESS_LIVE_EXECUTION_ENVELOPE input may be present;\\nnone is an authorization flag. The child clears that remaining environment.\\nManifest/public-key/signature/launcher bytes are read once under no-follow\\ncustody, verified with the unchanged signature/key contract, and retained by\\nthe dedicated process. Repeated internal native constructors use that verified\\nsnapshot; the envelope's launcher digest must equal it.\\n\\nBoth platform and tenant signatures and fixed trust-store digests are verified\\nbefore opening any envelope-selected reference, including the capacity file.\\nOnly then may that exact digest-bound capacity reference be read and its\\nindependent CAPACITY_OPERATOR signature and complete binding verified. Invalid\\nor forged references therefore never reach a file open; none grants execution.\\n\\nAuthority references use retained no-follow directory/file descriptors, exact\\nroot ownership, no write bits, single-link regular files, bounded reads and\\ninode/metadata rechecks. The signed kit is enumerated independently, with each\\nfile read once. It rejects symlinks, hard links, device crossings, unsupported\\nobjects, writable files, path aliases and inventory/digest drift. No warm\\ncheckout or ambient root filesystem is used as a kit. The source candidate's\\nFixed bounds are 4 MiB/file, 64 MiB total file data, 4096 files, 8192 total\\nentries, 4096 entries per directory and depth 32; the release must fit these\\nbounds or be unavailable.\\nA root-owned, nonwritable `rootfs/` inside that exact signed kit is required;\\nthere is no host filesystem fallback. Packaging/prerequisite qualification is\\nnot supplied by this packet.\\n\\nBefore any child checkout or credential access, trusted setup:\\n\\n1. Creates a supervisor-owned SOCK_SEQPACKET socketpair and a closed child gate;\\n   marks the dedicated parent a child subreaper.\\n2. Forks a trusted setup child and attaches it to the exclusively leased cgroup\\n   before releasing the gate. An ambiguous attach still requires cleanup.\\n3. Clears supplementary groups and creates user, mount, PID and network\\n   namespaces; the parent writes exact single-ID UID/GID maps to host 65532.\\n4. Re-arms parent-death SIGKILL after credential changes. PID-namespace init\\n   retains a parent pidfd to close the death-before-prctl race even when\\n   getppid() is zero across the namespace boundary.\\n5. Makes mount propagation private; recursively bind-mounts the signed rootfs\\n   read-only/nosuid/nodev and chroots into it. Closes all descriptors except the\\n   owned local channel; removes capabilities and enables no_new_privs.\\n6. Installs architecture-checked classic-BPF seccomp rules. Direct socket\\n   creation/connect/bind/listen, namespace escape, ptrace, BPF, userfaultfd,\\n   io_uring and pidfd_getfd paths are denied on amd64/arm64. x32 is rejected.\\n   clone3 returns ENOSYS; ordinary clone/fork is allowed only inside the\\n   PID namespace, limits and cgroup. This is a layered boundary, not a claim\\n   that a syscall denylist alone is a complete sandbox.\\n7. Reports READY through per-message SCM_CREDENTIALS. The parent checks the\\n   child's kernel identity, exact cgroup, distinct namespaces, mapped UID/GID,\\n   zero capability sets, seccomp and no_new_privs, and retains a pidfd.\\n\\nSO_PEERCRED from socketpair creation is deliberately not used as post-fork\\nsender identity. Truncated, duplicate or unexpected ancillary messages fail;\\nall received SCM_RIGHTS descriptors are closed and never become authority.\\nOnly the supervisor-created channel is used, with checks around every bounded\\noperation. The isolated custodian presently accepts only a fixed ping byte;\\nit does **not** yet execute probes or load tenant credentials.\\n\\nThe child uses an absolute monotonic deadline (at most 900 seconds and never\\npast signed expiry), recalculated before each receive so pings cannot extend\\nits life. Parent death kills the trusted intermediate parent and namespace\\ninit; PID namespace teardown kills remaining namespace processes. An alive\\nsupervisor's expiry/cancel/close path writes cgroup.kill and drains direct and\\nadopted children until both wait custody and cgroup emptiness are proved.\\nKernel/init reaping after supervisor death is a **native qualification gate**,\\nnot something offline mocks establish. After a parent crash, an occupied\\npreallocated leaf blocks the next session instead of being silently cleared.\\n\\n## Operator prerequisites — not performed here\\n\\nThe separately authorized native operator must provide a supported native\\n64-bit Linux host, Python 3.12.14 and the exact signed launcher, cgroup v2\\nincluding cgroup.kill, mount_setattr recursive read-only support, user/mount/\\nPID/network namespaces, pidfd, prctl/capset/seccomp, and enabled finite CPU/\\nmemory/PID controllers. Unsupported primitives have no subprocess/emulation/\\nuncontained fallback. Missing prerequisites are NOT_RUN_ENV_UNAVAILABLE, never\\nPASS; the later bridge owns mapping internal prerequisite exceptions into the\\nunchanged campaign result format.\\n\\nFixed, precreated paths (not user request parameters):\\n\\n- `/sys/fs/cgroup/planeon-live/session`: empty non-delegated cgroup-v2 domain.\\n- `/var/lib/planeon/live-backend`: root:root 0700.\\n- `session.lock` and `replay.jsonl` under that directory: root:root 0600,\\n  precreated regular files, no hard links. The journal starts empty once;\\n  never recreate it to clear consumed nonces.\\n- Existing root manifest, release trust and tenant trust fixed mounts under\\n  the unchanged trusted live-runner contract.\\n\\nNo install command, sudo policy, cluster/VM provisioning, rootfs creation,\\ncredential import, cloud API, hosted runner or network policy mutation is part\\nof this source run.\\n\\n## Handoff to CONF-LIVE-003 and remaining roadmap\\n\\nThe only production transport hook is the fixed relative import\\n`live_proxy_client.execute_protected(request, installed_context, deadline)`.\\nIt is intentionally absent until its owning packet. Caller data never chooses\\na transport/module/URL/argv. The context is constructed only by NativeSupervisor\\nand retains its owning supervisor, validated binding, plan, envelope, capacity,\\nsource digest and owned rootfs FD. These are private in-process custody data,\\nnot serializable session authority.\\n\\nThe privileged broker is distinct from the isolated child. CONF-LIVE-003 must\\nindependently enforce the single signed endpoint, TLS identity, no discovery/\\nredirect/proxy environment, bounded request/response/deadline, short-lived\\ncredential custody and server-side zero-cost quota admission. A live peer or\\nsuccessful ping grants none of those permissions by itself. CONF-LIVE-004\\nowns the ten real fixed probes. CONF-LIVE-005 owns deterministic candidate\\npackaging; CONF-LIVE-006 owns the closed integration delta. External operator\\ninstallation, native amd64/arm64 Linux, OCP/Kubernetes runtime, assurance and\\ntenant acceptance remain separate WAITING gates.\\n\\n## Offline verification and evidence boundaries\\n\\nRun only the packet's exact eight direct argv through the signed, root-owned\\noffline launcher in one deny-all-outbound process tree: all six unittest roots,\\nthen campaign linux-baseline and evidence-verify linux-baseline. No separate\\ntest execution or native syscall execution is permitted during coding/CI.\\n\\nNew tests cover reserve-before-child ordering; nonce contention; crashes before,\\nduring and after append/fsync/readback; consumed restart history; replay chain,\\nscope and timing; peer identity/FD spoofing; per-message credential rejection;\\nBPF instruction behavior for both ABIs and IPv4/IPv6/DNS/metadata denial;\\nnamespace-clone escape filtering; adapter failure ordering; cgroup attach\\nambiguity, adopted-child reaping and incomplete cleanup; one-operation locks,\\ncancellation, expired/late I/O and rollback; factory injection and unsigned\\nevidence. Syscalls are explicitly mocked; no test result is native\\ncontainment evidence. Inventory tests retain original 103/120, corrected\\n106/150, successor 110/170 and immediate 120/216 file/test checkpoints, including\\nfresh isolated discovery of all six roots without omission/skip/xfail.\\n\\nKeep local-source checks, GitHub CI, PR merge, local exact-main replay,\\ncandidate artifact/SBOM, installed preflight, native runtime, assurance and\\ntenant acceptance as independent states. Roll back this unconsumed increment\\nby a reviewed revert; after successor consumption use a corrective packet.\\nDo not alter installations, tenant resources, trust or replay history.\\n\\n## Design references\\n\\n- [Linux cgroup-v2 documentation](https://docs.kernel.org/admin-guide/cgroup-v2.html):\\n  process inheritance, resource limits and whole-cgroup kill behavior.\\n- [Linux seccomp filter documentation](https://www.kernel.org/doc/html/latest/userspace-api/seccomp_filter.html):\\n  architecture checks, no_new_privs and layered confinement.\\n- [Unix-domain socket credentials](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/unix.7.html):\\n  per-message SCM_CREDENTIALS versus socket-creation credentials.\\n- [User namespaces](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/user_namespaces.7.html):\\n  UID/GID mapping and supplementary-group ordering.\\n- [Parent-death signal](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/PR_SET_PDEATHSIG.2const.html)\\n  and [PID namespaces](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/pid_namespaces.7.html):\\n  re-arming, death races and PID-namespace init teardown.\\n- [Recursive mount attributes](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/mount_setattr.2.html):\\n  recursive read-only/nosuid/nodev enforcement.\\n\\n## Immutable immediate predecessor inventory\\n\\nThis is inert provenance data, never executable configuration. Its raw UTF-8\\nJSON (without a trailing newline) has SHA-256\\n`f2bc15e777afa6545c3fcfcdd63a0ddcba3d162783767083acb59e1744b115ac`, pinned independently in the new supervisor test.\\nOnly the previously accepted exact CONF-LIVE-006 hook proof can account for\\nthat final launcher delta; an integration filename alone never grants it.\\n\\n<!-- CONF-LIVE-001-BASELINE CONF-FIX-004 — retained custody correction\\n\\nAlpha 2 remains ONGOING. This is a SOURCE-ONLY candidate. Local acceptance,\\nrequired localhost CI, merge and independent local exact-main are separate\\npending gates until their exact commit/run records are published. No native\\nexecution, installation, server containment or tenant acceptance is asserted.\\n\\nAuthority: MET-REPAIR-011 at meta main\\n7447acd1a0471cecb79da36abe6b4ff0859f0a92, canonical amendment SHA-256\\n26d0301045c60908850ec225fa497d73da4c4125c377e74a931d41c83d57c491.\\nOriginal conformance checkpoint: 7205075d2f234b622dd61072803b754f1dffeb79,\\ntree c48d71a7c8d5ddf245e1aab8063ecd9ae2b59834, 127 files / 279 tests.\\nThe fence below retains that checkpoint as history, not corrected file hashes.\\n\\n### Ownership and handoff\\n\\nThe fixed NativeSupervisor constructor creates one process/thread-bound internal\\nregistry. A cached manifest digest, mocked reader return, caller FD, subclass,\\nforeign owner or deserialized object cannot complete its authority inventory.\\nStandalone legacy byte readers remain data-only and retain their signatures.\\n\\nThe registry retains every no-follow directory in the full chain, each regular\\nfile FD and immutable bytes, and the named inode plus type/owner/mode/link/size/\\nmtime/ctime snapshot. Installed identity is verified once into that registry;\\nsubsequent checks do not reopen any path or silently refresh trust. The signed\\nkit is enumerated once. Its verified rootfs directory is borrowed, not reopened.\\n\\nInstalledContext carries read-only _bytes (absolute retained authority paths)\\nand _kit (signed kit-relative bytes), plus original signed authority and a\\nbinding/plan snapshot. The fixed proxy successor consumes release/profile/CA/\\nobservation-binding bytes from these maps only. These internal objects are not\\npublic request APIs, independent signer proof, or native acceptance evidence.\\nThe proxy must check the genuine active owner/channel before any credential\\nor network operation and keep its own server-side admission requirements.\\n\\nA durable nonce reservation precedes containment. Every peer/request/hook\\nboundary rechecks retained custody, all three signer roles/windows and signed\\nscope. Wall and monotonic time cannot roll back or extend the original deadline;\\nchecks repeat after blocking channel and proxy operations. Changed authority\\nfails closed and is not re-enrolled. The fixed fork setup remains unchanged:\\nonly its required rootfs/channel are used; all other descriptors are closed\\nbefore isolated custodian operation. No authority data is sent over that channel.\\n\\n### Bounds and failure behavior\\n\\nExisting kit limits remain 4 MiB/file, 64 MiB kit data, 4096 kit files,\\n8192 kit entries, 4096 directory entries and kit depth 32. The complete registry\\nadds finite ceilings of 4112 files, 8448 descriptors, 96 MiB retained file bytes,\\n64 absolute path components and 4096 UTF-8 path bytes. Descriptors must be above\\nstdio and below the unchanged child's close-range ceiling. Kernel descriptor\\nexhaustion refuses immediately; no RLIMIT increase, reopen or partial fallback.\\n\\nRegistry invalidation precedes close attempts. Each descriptor number is removed\\nfrom ownership before a close can report failure and is never retried. A replaced\\ndescriptor is rejected without closing the unrelated replacement. Cleanup\\ncontinues after individual errors. Clock failures cannot prevent containment\\ncleanup. An ambiguous reservation consumes the instance; consumed journal\\nhistory is never reset. Unproven cleanup/time leaves no successful terminal\\nrecord. Parent/native crash recovery remains a separately qualified Linux gate.\\n\\nThe four fixed runtime resource descriptors (session lock, cgroup, journal and\\njournal directory) are separately registered from the constructor's own objects,\\nnot from an ambient-FD enumeration. The owned channel/pidfd pair is admitted only\\nafter kernel peer validation. Ambient injection is rechecked before containment\\nand around each operation. These six fixed descriptors are additional to the\\n8448 retained authority/ancestor limit. Journal cleanup takes its two descriptors\\nonce and attempts both even after an error; transaction and replay bytes remain\\nunchanged. Original retained inode identities prevent closing a recycled journal\\ndescriptor as if it were still owned.\\n\\n### Regression and evidence boundaries\\n\\nAppend-only regressions exercise the actual native factory, signature and\\ncustody checks, reservation, channel and fixed-hook dispatch using explicit\\nin-memory OS observations. They do not patch an eligibility check to PASS.\\nThey cover all retained paths and ancestor metadata; read-once/rootfs reuse;\\neach signer's expiry/revocation; forged/foreign/forked contexts; exhaustion and\\nread errors; post-I/O substitution; cancellation, clock failure, ambiguous\\nreservation and close-error cleanup. All results remain UNIT_VERIFICATION_ONLY.\\n\\nThe appended stdlib-only source guard reuses the pinned data-only region oracle,\\nchecks all five corrected files and every unchanged file in the original\\n127-path inventory, preserves all original test/document bytes, and compares\\nfresh unittest collection to AST identity lists in all six roots. Stored source\\ntext is never compiled, imported or executed.\\n\\n| Phase | ID / gate | Status in this source candidate |\\n| --- | --- | --- |\\n| Phase 0 / Alpha 1 | Recorded foundations | DONE source/offline; live evidence separate |\\n| Alpha 2 | MET-REPAIR-011 | DONE authority publication and source gates |\\n| Alpha 2 | CONF-FIX-004 | ONGOING; local/CI/merge/exact-main recorded separately |\\n| Alpha 2 | CONF-LIVE-003 | WAITING for corrected predecessor source closure |\\n| Alpha 2 | CONF-LIVE-004/005/006 | WAITING probes, packaging and integration |\\n| Alpha 2 | Native AMD64 / ARM64 | NOT_RUN_ENV_UNAVAILABLE |\\n| Alpha 3 / Alpha 4 | Governed actions / enterprise matrix | WAITING |\\n\\nRollback before successor consumption is a reviewed revert of only these five\\npaths. Afterwards use a reviewed correction; retain both source checkpoints and\\nall failed evidence. No trust/replay/tenant-data rollback. No predecessor, dispatcher, workflow, source\\\\\\\\n  lock, public schema, signature role or PORTING record changes.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## Components and state\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n| Component | Dependency and responsibility | State / failure |\\\\\\\\n| --- | --- | --- |\\\\\\\\n| NativeSupervisor | Fixed installed launcher custody, three independent signature roles, exact signed files and kit, native adapter | One session per dedicated process; no caller context or backend argument |\\\\\\\\n| Native channel | Owned socketpair; per-message kernel credentials; pidfd, PID/start/cgroup/UID/GID/capability/namespace checks | Validate before and after blocking operations; death/EOF/cancellation invalidates handle |\\\\\\\\n| Cgroup lease | Preallocated empty root-owned cgroup-v2 leaf, finite CPU/memory/PID limits, exclusive session lock | Attach before releasing child gate; kill whole leaf, drain adopted descendants, prove populated=0 |\\\\\\\\n| Replay journal | Root-only no-follow file, exclusive flock, chained canonical JSONL, append + fsync + readback | RESERVED before child creation, RUNNING before operations, terminal only after cleanup |\\\\\\\\n| UnitSupervisor / UnitBoundary / UnitReplayStore | Explicit injected unit adapters | UNIT_VERIFICATION_ONLY, never installed authority |\\\\\\\\n| Fixed proxy successor | CONF-LIVE-003, later protected network/admission implementation | Missing module is PROTECTED_PROXY_UNAVAILABLE; no fallback |\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nLifecycle:\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n`VALIDATED_DATA -> durable RESERVED -> containment + peer checks -> RUNNING -> COMPLETED / FAILED / CANCELLED / EXPIRED`\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nTerminal states have no outgoing edge. Only all ten fixed, distinct passing\\\\\\\\noperations can complete. A failed or unavailable operation closes the session;\\\\\\\\nan unavailable operation's receipt stays NOT_RUN_ENV_UNAVAILABLE. Cancellation\\\\\\\\nracing an already executing operation may end in FAILED (interrupted I/O) or\\\\\\\\nCANCELLED; neither permits reuse. Cleanup failure or clock rollback can leave\\\\\\\\nthe durable record RESERVED/RUNNING **consumed**, with no fabricated terminal\\\\\\\\nreceipt. Journal read errors, torn writes, uncertain fsync/readback, full storage\\\\\\\\nand custody changes all refuse execution. No truncation, repair, nonce expiry,\\\\\\\\nrotation or automatic lease recovery is implemented.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nAn append failure before any byte reaches storage may leave an empty journal\\\\\\\\nafter process restart. That is safe only because execution never precedes a\\\\\\\\nsuccessful durable reservation. Any complete or partial reservation survives\\\\\\\\nas consumed or as a globally refusing corrupted journal. Root/operator\\\\\\\\ntampering, disk rollback, hardware lying about fsync and hostile kernels are\\\\\\\\noutside this source candidate's trust boundary; production backup/restore must\\\\\\\\npreserve replay history and never restore a reusable old nonce ledger.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## Native boundary and custody\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nThe production constructor accepts no path, executable, callback, module name,\\\\\\\\nstorage adapter, FD, token or verified flag. It requires Linux, root UID/GID,\\\\\\\\none thread, no preexisting children and default SIGCHLD disposition; the\\\\\\\\nmodule must be loaded from the exact installed launcher archive and its\\\\\\\\nindependently signed root manifest must verify. The unchanged legacy launcher\\\\\\\\ncontinues to refuse live execution until the separately owned CONF-LIVE-006\\\\\\\\nbridge and external installation gates are complete.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nThe native entry also rejects ambient credentials, proxy/import variables and\\\\\\\\nopen descriptors beyond nonsocket stdio. Only PATH, HOME, USER, LOGNAME, LANG,\\\\\\\\nLC_ALL, TZ and the fixed HARNESS_LIVE_EXECUTION_ENVELOPE input may be present;\\\\\\\\nnone is an authorization flag. The child clears that remaining environment.\\\\\\\\nManifest/public-key/signature/launcher bytes are read once under no-follow\\\\\\\\ncustody, verified with the unchanged signature/key contract, and retained by\\\\\\\\nthe dedicated process. Repeated internal native constructors use that verified\\\\\\\\nsnapshot; the envelope's launcher digest must equal it.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nBoth platform and tenant signatures and fixed trust-store digests are verified\\\\\\\\nbefore opening any envelope-selected reference, including the capacity file.\\\\\\\\nOnly then may that exact digest-bound capacity reference be read and its\\\\\\\\nindependent CAPACITY_OPERATOR signature and complete binding verified. Invalid\\\\\\\\nor forged references therefore never reach a file open; none grants execution.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nAuthority references use retained no-follow directory/file descriptors, exact\\\\\\\\nroot ownership, no write bits, single-link regular files, bounded reads and\\\\\\\\ninode/metadata rechecks. The signed kit is enumerated independently, with each\\\\\\\\nfile read once. It rejects symlinks, hard links, device crossings, unsupported\\\\\\\\nobjects, writable files, path aliases and inventory/digest drift. No warm\\\\\\\\ncheckout or ambient root filesystem is used as a kit. The source candidate's\\\\\\\\nFixed bounds are 4 MiB/file, 64 MiB total file data, 4096 files, 8192 total\\\\\\\\nentries, 4096 entries per directory and depth 32; the release must fit these\\\\\\\\nbounds or be unavailable.\\\\\\\\nA root-owned, nonwritable `rootfs/` inside that exact signed kit is required;\\\\\\\\nthere is no host filesystem fallback. Packaging/prerequisite qualification is\\\\\\\\nnot supplied by this packet.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nBefore any child checkout or credential access, trusted setup:\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n1. Creates a supervisor-owned SOCK_SEQPACKET socketpair and a closed child gate;\\\\\\\\n   marks the dedicated parent a child subreaper.\\\\\\\\n2. Forks a trusted setup child and attaches it to the exclusively leased cgroup\\\\\\\\n   before releasing the gate. An ambiguous attach still requires cleanup.\\\\\\\\n3. Clears supplementary groups and creates user, mount, PID and network\\\\\\\\n   namespaces; the parent writes exact single-ID UID/GID maps to host 65532.\\\\\\\\n4. Re-arms parent-death SIGKILL after credential changes. PID-namespace init\\\\\\\\n   retains a parent pidfd to close the death-before-prctl race even when\\\\\\\\n   getppid() is zero across the namespace boundary.\\\\\\\\n5. Makes mount propagation private; recursively bind-mounts the signed rootfs\\\\\\\\n   read-only/nosuid/nodev and chroots into it. Closes all descriptors except the\\\\\\\\n   owned local channel; removes capabilities and enables no_new_privs.\\\\\\\\n6. Installs architecture-checked classic-BPF seccomp rules. Direct socket\\\\\\\\n   creation/connect/bind/listen, namespace escape, ptrace, BPF, userfaultfd,\\\\\\\\n   io_uring and pidfd_getfd paths are denied on amd64/arm64. x32 is rejected.\\\\\\\\n   clone3 returns ENOSYS; ordinary clone/fork is allowed only inside the\\\\\\\\n   PID namespace, limits and cgroup. This is a layered boundary, not a claim\\\\\\\\n   that a syscall denylist alone is a complete sandbox.\\\\\\\\n7. Reports READY through per-message SCM_CREDENTIALS. The parent checks the\\\\\\\\n   child's kernel identity, exact cgroup, distinct namespaces, mapped UID/GID,\\\\\\\\n   zero capability sets, seccomp and no_new_privs, and retains a pidfd.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nSO_PEERCRED from socketpair creation is deliberately not used as post-fork\\\\\\\\nsender identity. Truncated, duplicate or unexpected ancillary messages fail;\\\\\\\\nall received SCM_RIGHTS descriptors are closed and never become authority.\\\\\\\\nOnly the supervisor-created channel is used, with checks around every bounded\\\\\\\\noperation. The isolated custodian presently accepts only a fixed ping byte;\\\\\\\\nit does **not** yet execute probes or load tenant credentials.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nThe child uses an absolute monotonic deadline (at most 900 seconds and never\\\\\\\\npast signed expiry), recalculated before each receive so pings cannot extend\\\\\\\\nits life. Parent death kills the trusted intermediate parent and namespace\\\\\\\\ninit; PID namespace teardown kills remaining namespace processes. An alive\\\\\\\\nsupervisor's expiry/cancel/close path writes cgroup.kill and drains direct and\\\\\\\\nadopted children until both wait custody and cgroup emptiness are proved.\\\\\\\\nKernel/init reaping after supervisor death is a **native qualification gate**,\\\\\\\\nnot something offline mocks establish. After a parent crash, an occupied\\\\\\\\npreallocated leaf blocks the next session instead of being silently cleared.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## Operator prerequisites — not performed here\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nThe separately authorized native operator must provide a supported native\\\\\\\\n64-bit Linux host, Python 3.12.14 and the exact signed launcher, cgroup v2\\\\\\\\nincluding cgroup.kill, mount_setattr recursive read-only support, user/mount/\\\\\\\\nPID/network namespaces, pidfd, prctl/capset/seccomp, and enabled finite CPU/\\\\\\\\nmemory/PID controllers. Unsupported primitives have no subprocess/emulation/\\\\\\\\nuncontained fallback. Roll back this unconsumed increment\\\\\\\\nby a reviewed revert; after successor consumption use a corrective packet.\\\\\\\\nDo not alter installations, tenant resources, trust or replay history.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## Design references\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- [Linux cgroup-v2 documentation](https://docs.kernel.org/admin-guide/cgroup-v2.html):\\\\\\\\n  process inheritance, resource limits and whole-cgroup kill behavior.\\\\\\\\n- [Linux seccomp filter documentation](https://www.kernel.org/doc/html/latest/userspace-api/seccomp_filter.html):\\\\\\\\n  architecture checks, no_new_privs and layered confinement.\\\\\\\\n- [Unix-domain socket credentials](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/unix.7.html):\\\\\\\\n  per-message SCM_CREDENTIALS versus socket-creation credentials.\\\\\\\\n- [User namespaces](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/user_namespaces.7.html):\\\\\\\\n  UID/GID mapping and supplementary-group ordering.\\\\\\\\n- [Parent-death signal](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/PR_SET_PDEATHSIG.2const.html)\\\\\\\\n  and [PID namespaces](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/pid_namespaces.7.html):\\\\\\\\n  re-arming, death races and PID-namespace init teardown.\\\\\\\\n- [Recursive mount attributes](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/mount_setattr.2.html):\\\\\\\\n  recursive read-only/nosuid/nodev enforcement.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## Immutable immediate predecessor inventory\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nThis is inert provenance data, never executable configuration. ## CONF-PERF-004 — reference-measured private arithmetic repair

This additive v4 proof establishes eight-file source scope only. All 327 inherited
identities and unchanged behavioral bodies remain mandatory. The original-crypto
scaffold is committed before the separately signed CONF-BENCH-001 read-only
measurement. One fixed benchmark must complete three matched samples and full
workload attribution before any arithmetic selection. It is not whole-suite
acceptance. The candidate must pass all eight full commands, independent
arithmetic and source regressions, matched median ratio <= 0.85, local and local
exact-main elapsed <= 750 seconds, required localhost CI and green-only merge.
No failed draft is an accepted checkpoint. Fresh signed custody and full logs are
retained externally; source reports alone do not verify signatures or grant
authority. Native runtime and tenant acceptance remain separate. No timeout,
download, root policy, credential or billing boundary is changed.
